notes: Item 19 is present and well-populated with multiple tables. Part I covers all 86 franchised spas open at least 12 months as of Dec 31, 2024, broken into quartiles by gross revenue and three metrics (Gross Revenue, Prospect Visits, New Members). Additional cohorts segment by opening year vintages: 2008-2012 (18 spas), 2013-2017 (31 spas), 2018-2022/2023 (37 spas). Part II provides a full P&L income statement for 16 selected franchisee units opened prior to 2022. One anomaly noted: Table 19.10 Total row shows Ave Prospect Visits of 4,531 which exceeds the stated maximum of 4,306 - this is reproduced faithfully from source. Section heading for Table 19.9 reads 'In 2023' but table title and data clearly indicate 2024 data; treated as 2024. Tables 19.4, 19.8, 19.12, and 19.16 are labeled as recap/presentation-only tables summarizing data already captured in other tables; they are not extracted as separate records to avoid duplication. Facilities Expense metric_name set to 'other' (not 'occupancy_pct') since values are dollar amounts not percentages.
